title: Helix: Serving Large Language Models over Heterogeneous GPUs and Network via Max-Flow
authors: Yixuan Mei; Yonghao Zhuang; Xupeng Miao; Juncheng Yang; Zhihao Jia; Rashmi Vinayak
venue_full: ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS) 2025
research_focus: LLM serving on heterogeneous and geo-distributed GPU clusters

problem_statement.en: Existing high-throughput LLM serving systems assume a homogeneous cluster of identical GPUs on a uniform interconnect, but production fleets increasingly mix a few flagship accelerators (H100, A100) with large numbers of cheaper inference GPUs (L4, T4) spread across regions joined by slow wide-area links. Naive model placement and request scheduling cannot extract throughput from such hardware: uniform partitioning idles strong GPUs behind weak ones, and compute-balanced placement that ignores the network congests slow inter-region links.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的高吞吐量 LLM 服務系統假設叢集由相同 GPU 組成、連在均質互連上，但生產機隊越來越常混用少量旗艦加速器（H100、A100）與大量較便宜的推論級 GPU（L4、T4），且分散在以慢速廣域連線相接的各區域。簡單的模型放置與請求排程無法從這種硬體榨出吞吐量：均勻切分使強 GPU 被弱 GPU 拖住而閒置，而忽略網路、僅平衡運算的放置又會壅塞慢速的跨區連線。

key_innovation.en: Helix is the first system to jointly optimize model placement and request scheduling for heterogeneous GPU clusters. It proves that, for a fixed placement, maximum serving throughput equals the max-flow of a directed graph whose edge capacities encode the per-second token throughput of each GPU and network link. A mixed-integer linear program with a linear number of variables and constraints then searches over layer assignments to maximize that max-flow, and a runtime 'per-request pipeline' scheduler routes every request along its own source-to-sink path via interleaved weighted round-robin whose weights come from the optimal flow.
key_innovation.zh: Helix 是第一個針對異質 GPU 叢集同時最佳化模型放置與請求排程的系統。它證明：對固定放置而言，最大服務吞吐量等於一張有向圖的最大流，其邊容量編碼每顆 GPU 與每條網路連線每秒的 token 吞吐量。接著以一個變數與約束數量皆為線性的混合整數線性規劃，在層分配空間中搜尋以最大化該最大流；執行時期的「逐請求管線」排程器則以取自最優流量的權重，透過交錯加權輪詢將每個請求路由至各自的源到匯路徑。

baselines_compared: Petals (greedy decentralized placement), Swarm / SWARM Parallelism (compute-balanced pipeline stages), Separate Pipelines (one full pipeline per machine type), random and shortest-queue scheduling

key_improvements.en: Up to 3.3x higher serving throughput and up to 66% lower prompt latency / 24% lower decode latency vs. baselines (abstract headline). Detailed results: 2.14x over Swarm on single-cluster LLaMA-30B offline; 1.94x over Swarm and 1.86x over Separate Pipelines on LLaMA-70B offline; ~2.0x over Swarm and ~1.5x over Separate Pipelines on the geo-distributed cluster; 2.72x over Separate Pipelines on the 42-node, 7-GPU-type cluster.
key_improvements.zh: 服務吞吐量最高提升 3.3 倍，prompt 延遲最高降低 66%、decode 延遲最高降低 24%（摘要標題數字）。詳細結果：單叢集 LLaMA-30B 離線相較 Swarm 為 2.14 倍；LLaMA-70B 離線相較 Swarm 為 1.94 倍、相較 Separate Pipelines 為 1.86 倍；跨區域叢集相較 Swarm 約 2.0 倍、相較 Separate Pipelines 約 1.5 倍；42 節點、7 種 GPU 的叢集相較 Separate Pipelines 為 2.72 倍。

software_simulator: Custom high-fidelity discrete-event simulator (14k LoC Python), validated to <5% error against the prototype on all metrics
network_topology: Single region (24 nodes, 10 Gb/s intra) and 3-region geo-distributed (10 Gb/s intra-region, 100 Mb/s / 50 ms inter-region)
traffic_pattern: Heterogeneous pipeline parallelism, per-request pipelines, online and offline serving over Azure Conversation and Code traces
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 (40/80 GB), V100, L4 (24 GB), T4 (16 GB) — heterogeneous mix; up to 7 GPU types
network_hw: Commodity Ethernet (10 Gb/s intra-region, 100 Mb/s inter-region links)
transport_and_interconnect: ZeroMQ over TCP for inter-node communication
routing_and_congestion_control: Max-flow-weighted interleaved weighted round-robin (IWRR) with KV-cache high-water-mark masking
reported_accuracy: <5% error vs. prototype on all metrics (throughput, prompt latency, decode latency)
parallelism_coverage: Heterogeneous pipeline parallelism (per-request pipelines); tensor parallelism within multi-GPU nodes
batching_policy: Best-effort dynamic batching (includes all requests arrived during the previous batch, no extra waiting)
kv_cache_treatment: Unified page pool atop vLLM enabling partial inference; per-node expected-KV tracking with high-water-mark masking to prevent OOM
validation_workloads: Azure LLM Conversation and Azure LLM Code traces
tail_latency: Reports full prompt- and decode-latency distributions; geo-distributed Swarm reaches ~70 s average prompt latency for LLaMA-70B vs. far lower for Helix
downstream_use: MILP-based model placement search and per-request pipeline scheduling within the Helix serving system

scope_assumptions.en: Static per-cluster placement (each node holds one contiguous block of layers); MILP given a 10-min per-cluster timeout and 4-hour total budget on a 14-core CPU; for hundreds of nodes the fleet is partitioned into sub-clusters solved independently; KV usage estimated from average output length.
scope_assumptions.zh: 每個叢集為靜態放置（每個節點持有一段連續的層）；MILP 每叢集逾時 10 分鐘、在 14 核 CPU 上共 4 小時搜尋預算；對於數百節點則先將機隊劃分為子叢集再各自獨立求解；KV 使用量由平均輸出長度估算。

source.method: manual extraction from arXiv:2406.01566v1 and Thesys-lab/Helix-ASPLOS25 repo
